title: अध्यागमन विभागका महानिर्देशकसहित केही जिल्लाका सिडिओ सरुवा
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । गृह मन्त्रालयले राजपत्राङ्कित प्रथम श्रेणी (सहसचिव) का ९ कर्मचारीको सरुवा तथा पदस्थापना गरेको छ। मन्त्रालयको मङ्सिर ११ गतेको निर्णयअनुसार पर्सा, सिन्धुपाल्चोक, रामेछाप, दैलेख, महोत्तरी, प्युठान र सिन्धुली गरी विभिन्न जिल्लाका प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी (प्रजिअ) तथा विभागीय प्रमुखहरूको हेरफेर गरिएको हो । पर्साका प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी भोला दाहाललाई गृह मन्त्रालय, सिंहदरबारमा सरुवा गरिएको छ भने गृह मन्त्रालयका सहसचिव एकदेव अधिकारीलाई पर्साको प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारीका रूपमा पठाइएको छ। त्यस्तै, सिन्धुपाल्चोकका प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी शशीधर घिमिरेलाई अध्यागमन विभाग, कालिकास्थानको महानिर्देशकमा सरुवा गरिएको छ । अध्यागमन विभागका महानिर्देशक रामचन्द्र तिवारीलाई राष्ट्रिय विपद् जोखिम न्यूनीकरण तथा व्यवस्थापन प्राधिकरणको सहसचिवमा सरुवा गरिएको छ। यसैगरी, गृह मन्त्रालय वा अन्तर्गत कार्यरत ५ जना सहसचिवलाई विभिन्न जिल्लाको प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारीका रूपमा पदस्थापना गरिएको छ। Kathmandu. The Ministry of Home Affairs has transferred and posted nine gazetted first class (joint secretary) employees. As per the ministry's decision on November 21, the Chief District Officers (CDOs) and department heads of various districts including Parsa, Sindhupalchowk, Ramechhap, Dailekh, Mahottari, Pyuthan and Sindhuli have been reshuffled. Parsa Chief District Officer Bhola Dahal has been transferred to the Ministry of Home Affairs, Singha Durbar, while Ekdev Adhikari, Joint Secretary at the Ministry of Home Affairs, has been sent as the Chief District Officer of Parsa. Similarly, Sindhupalchowk Chief District Officer Shashidhar Ghimire has been transferred to the position of Director General of the Immigration Department, Kalikasthan. Ram Chandra Tiwari, Director General of the Department of Immigration, has been transferred to the position of Joint Secretary of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority. Similarly, five joint secretaries working in or under the Ministry of Home Affairs have been appointed as Chief District Officers of various districts.

As per the ministry's decision on November 21, the Chief District Officers (CDOs) and department heads of various districts including Parsa, Sindhupalchowk, Ramechhap, Dailekh, Mahottari, Pyuthan and Sindhuli have been reshuffled.

Parsa Chief District Officer Bhola Dahal has been transferred to the Ministry of Home Affairs, Singha Durbar, while Ekdev Adhikari, Joint Secretary at the Ministry of Home Affairs, has been sent as the Chief District Officer of Parsa.

Similarly, Sindhupalchowk Chief District Officer Shashidhar Ghimire has been transferred to the position of Director General of the Immigration Department, Kalikasthan.

Ram Chandra Tiwari, Director General of the Department of Immigration, has been transferred to the position of Joint Secretary of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.

Similarly, five joint secretaries working in or under the Ministry of Home Affairs have been appointed as Chief District Officers of various districts.
